reconfigure.title: 🔄 Reconfigure RTS
reconfigure.description:
Current transmitter: {transmitter}

Select the RF transmitter to use from now on. Every device and sensor of this entry will follow.

add_group.title: 👥 Add a Cover Group
add_group.description: A cover group drives several covers with a single RTS frame. Only covers can be members, not lights or sockets. It is not a device: no travel times, no options. Members are paired on the next step (or from the options menu once the entry is created).

data_description.address: Leave empty to generate an address in the reserved RTS group range.

manage_group.title: 🪟 Manage Cover Group Members
manage_group.description: Select the cover group whose members you want to change.

manage_group_members.title: 🪟 Cover Group Members
manage_group_members.description: Check the covers that belong to the group {group}. Each change sends the RTS programming sequence (a few seconds per cover).

data_description.device_index: Checked covers are paired to the group; unchecked covers are unpaired.

member_memory.title: 🔧 Open the motor memory
member_memory.description: The gateway holds a long PROG press on {cover}'s address (about five seconds, until the burst completes): its motor should react with a short back-and-forth jog (memory open). If it does not move, open the memory yourself: hold PROG on a paired remote until the motor jogs, then submit. The pairing press will be sent as soon as you submit.

member_pair_confirm.title: ✅ Confirm the cover group change
member_pair_confirm.description: The {group} PROG press was sent to {cover}: the motor should react again (pairing confirmed). If nothing happened, submit again to resend it.

abort.no_transmitters: No compatible RF transmitter found. Set up an ESPHome device with a CC1101 (or OOK transmitter) and its radio_frequency entity first.
abort.already_configured: A config entry for this RF transmitter already exists.

error.invalid_address: Address must be an 8-digit number between 00000000 and 16777215.
error.address_in_use: This address is already used by another device.
error.transmission_failed: The RF transmission failed. Check that the transmitter entity is available.
error.pair_not_confirmed: The motor did not react to the group PROG press. It was resent; confirm as soon as it reacts.
error.memory_not_opened: The motor did not react: its memory is not open. Submit again or open it with a paired remote.

remove_device.title: 🗑️ Remove a Device
remove_device.description: Select the device to remove from the integration.

data_description.unpair: Checked: the gateway opens the motor's memory then removes its address — the group addresses it is a member of are unpaired first — it will no longer respond to the gateway. Unchecked: the device is only removed from Home Assistant; the motor keeps the gateway address.

remove_remote.description: Select the device from which to unlink a remote.

remove_remote_confirm.title: 🎮 Confirm the Unlinking
remove_remote_confirm.description: Remote addresses linked to {name}. The physical remote keeps working with the motor; only the tracking in Home Assistant is removed.

add_group.description: A cover group drives several covers with a single RTS frame. Only covers can be members, not lights or sockets. It is not a device: no travel times, no options. Members are paired on the next step (or from the options menu once the entry is created).

member_memory.title: 🔧 Open the motor memory
member_memory.description: The gateway holds a long PROG press on {cover}'s address (about five seconds, until the burst completes): its motor should react with a short back-and-forth jog (memory open). If it does not move, open the memory yourself: hold PROG on a paired remote until the motor jogs, then submit. The pairing press will be sent as soon as you submit.

remove_group_confirm.title: 🗑️ Confirm the Cover Group Removal
remove_group_confirm.description: The group {group} ({count} member(s)) will be removed. With unpairing enabled, each member motor goes through the guided PROG sequence to forget the group address; without it, the motors keep the address but nobody transmits it anymore.

data.unpair: Unpair the group address from each member

remove_device_memory.title: 🔧 Open the motor memory
remove_device_memory.description: The gateway holds a long PROG press on {name}'s address (about five seconds, until the burst completes): its motor should react with a short back-and-forth jog (memory open). If it does not move, open the memory yourself: hold PROG on a paired remote until the motor jogs, then submit. Address currently being unpaired: {target}.

remove_device_unpair.title: ✅ Confirm the unpairing
remove_device_unpair.description: The unpair PROG press was sent to {name} for '{target}': the motor should react again (unpair confirmed). If nothing happened, submit again to resend it. When several addresses must be unpaired, the sequence repeats for each one; once the last one is confirmed, the motor no longer responds to the gateway.

link_remote.name: Link physical remote
link_remote.description: Links a physical remote to a cover so that its usage updates the cover state.

remote_address.name: Remote address
remote_address.description: The 8-digit RTS address of the physical remote.

unlink_remote.name: Unlink physical remote
unlink_remote.description: Unlinks a physical remote from a cover.

remote_address.name: Remote address
remote_address.description: The 8-digit RTS address of the physical remote.

set_my_position.name: Set My position
set_my_position.description: Stores the My (favorite) position of a cover.

position.name: Position
position.description: The favorite position of the cover.

goto_my_position.name: Go to My position
goto_my_position.description: Moves a cover to its configured My (favorite) position.

set_position.name: Realign position
set_position.description: Corrects the estimated position without moving the motor.

position.name: Position
position.description: The actual position of the cover.

set_tilt_position.name: Realign tilt position
set_tilt_position.description: Corrects the estimated tilt without moving the motor.

tilt_position.name: Tilt position
tilt_position.description: The actual tilt position of the cover.

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Sends any RTS command on the cover's address (pair extra motors to a group with PROG).

send_step_command.name: Send step command
send_step_command.description: Sends a step command with an explicit step size (80-bit only).

step_size.name: Step size
step_size.description: The step size sent in the frames (1-127).

recalibrate.name: Recalibrate position
recalibrate.description: Re-anchors the position estimate: travel to the nearest end stop, then back to the starting position. Run it from an automation at night to compensate the long-term drift of RTS covers.

enter_programming_mode.name: Enter programming mode
enter_programming_mode.description: Long PROG press (frame repeated 35 times): the motor briefly moves and stays in programming mode for a few seconds. Follow with send_prog to pair or unpair.

send_prog.name: Send PROG command
send_prog.description: Short PROG press: while the motor is in programming mode this pairs the gateway address; pressing it again unpairs it.

memorize_my_position.name: Memorize My position
memorize_my_position.description: Long MY press: the motor memorizes its current position as its native favorite. The same position is recorded in Home Assistant. Only meaningful for covers with simulate_my disabled.

add_to_group.name: Add to RTS group
add_to_group.description: Pairs covers to an RTS group: each motor enters its programming mode, then receives the group PROG press.

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: The covers to pair to the group.

group.name: Group
group.description: The group entity to pair the covers to.

remove_from_group.name: Remove from RTS group
remove_from_group.description: Unpairs covers from an RTS group with the same PROG toggle.

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: The covers to unpair from the group.

group.name: Group
group.description: The group entity to unpair the covers from.

transmitter_missing.title: The RF transmitter entity no longer exists
transmitter_missing.description: The radio transmitter `{transmitter}` configured for this integration no longer exists. The gateway may have been removed, replaced or renamed. Reconfigure the integration and pick the new transmitter entity, or remove the integration if the gateway is gone.
